description:
**Original Webtoon:**    
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=856510), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=14887759)

"Is it really such a sin that I... didn't recognize you, Senior?"

Jung Min-Ha ends up drinking at the end-of-semester party because she stared at an unfamiliar senior while following the crush she liked. "Do you think you're the first one like you?" Ki Shin-Woo makes cryptic remarks while making Min-Ha drink. Intoxicated and losing consciousness, Min-Ha accidentally bangs her head right into Shin-Woo's 'crotch'. Though a horribly embarrassing black mark was made in her past, it was fortunately soon forgotten—and now, 5 years later. Min-Ha is working as a graduate student and a professor's assistant.

"This person is... from back then...!"    
 "Did you figure out who I am, Jung Min-ha?"

Wait... the professor in charge of her is none other than Ki Shin-Woo...?
